value.rationale: Matching a periodic convolution with an open-path variation geometry models a real boundary-handling choice in finite filtering. The exact mass-law invariance under all interior kernel weights, a complete sharp n,m classification with the 2n/3 contraction boundary, and the counterintuitive initial growth 2-2^{-r} under repeated positive averaging constitute a mathematically motivated exact stability theory rather than an arbitrary small table.
